description: List every submission (one row per student's attempt history) for a Classic quiz, including each submission's score, kept_score, workflow_state, and any extra_time / extra_attempts accommodation Canvas has recorded for that student. Find the quiz_id with list_quizzes or get_quiz. To see a submission's actual answers, use get_quiz_submission_answers for an in-progress attempt or get_quiz_question_responses for a submitted one; to change a score use score_quiz_question. Fetches every page (100 per request) and fails with a 'Results are incomplete' error instead of silently truncating.
name: list_quiz_submissions
title: List Quiz Submissions
